title: Done, But Still Working: Anytime Evaluation of When Coding Agents Should Stop
abstract: arXiv:2611.22901v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Coding agents often continue working after their own tests pass. Does this additional work improve the patch, and how much could be saved by stopping earlier? We study these questions through anytime evaluation: replaying recorded runs, scoring intermediate patches with hidden tests, and measuring the cost incurred at each step. For policies that only stop a run or select an earlier patch, this allows paired comparisons without generating new trajectories, provided replay preserves the relevant states. Across about 6,000 runs of eight open models in two scaffolds on SWE-bench Verified, we find substantial differences in the value of continued work. The hindsight saving available at passing self-tests ranges from under 1% to 57%, depending on the model and scaffold. A rule that stops after the same patch passes twice saves 23% in a preregistered replication, but the preregistered quality test does not establish non-inferiority. We explain

translated_title: 已完成但仍继续工作：编码智能体何时应该停止的即时评估
translated_abstract: 编码智能体在自身测试通过后常常会继续工作。这些额外的工作是否改进了补丁？提前停止又能节省多少成本？我们通过即时评估来研究这些问题：重放已记录的运行轨迹，用隐藏测试对中间补丁进行评分，并测量每一步产生的成本。对于仅停止运行或选择较早补丁的策略，这种方法可以在不生成新轨迹的情况下进行配对比较，前提是重放能够保留相关状态。通过对八个开源模型在两种脚手架框架上于SWE-bench Verified数据集进行的约6000次运行的分析，我们发现持续工作的价值存在显著差异。在自测通过时可获得的回顾性节省幅度从不足1%到57%不等，具体取决于模型和脚手架。一条“相同补丁两次通过后即停止”的规则在预注册的复制实验中节省了23%的成本，但预注册的质量测试并未确立其非劣性。我们解释了……
tldr: 该论文提出“即时评估”方法，通过重放编码智能体的运行轨迹并用隐藏测试评分中间补丁，发现智能体在自测通过后继续工作的价值因模型而异（潜在节省1%至57%），且验证了“相同补丁两次通过后即停止”的规则可节省23%的成本但未证明质量不劣化。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces an anytime evaluation method that replays coding agent runs to score intermediate patches with hidden tests, revealing that the value of continued work after self-tests pass varies widely across models (1% to 57% potential savings), and validating that a rule of stopping once the same patch passes twice saves 23% of cost, though its quality non-inferiority remains unproven.
